rule:
Restrained validation master for the replacement candidates — ONLY for a
voice whose raw source passed the gate (raw_source_gate.py / pause_floor.py).

Rule (the Oct 13 'Guarded' shape plus the two approved refinements):
1. trim to speech (-50 dBFS envelope, 40 ms margin) — unchanged;
2. 10 ms raised-cosine fade at each trim edge (refinement 2);
3. outlier correction only: a part/close clip more than 2 LU from the voice's
   median part level is moved just to the edge of that window; every clip
   inside the window keeps its generated level;
4. ONE voice-wide gain so the five-clip take reads -22 LUFS, the level of the
   approved Locke/Heather masters (comparison at equal loudness);
5. peak safety only: 4x-oversampled look-ahead limiter at -2 dBFS, engaged
   only where a clip's true peak would exceed it, delay-compensated
   (alimiter latency=1, refinement 1). Every engagement is reported;
6. 150 ms lead-in; 700 ms tail after a lead, 400 ms after a part/close;
7. AAC-LC .m4a, mono, 44.1 kHz, 128 kbit/s, fingerprinted names.
No denoise, no spectral processing, no expander, no compression, no EQ.

A voice that FAILED the gate gets no master: only its as-generated file and
a gain-only, level-matched copy of it (one linear gain for the whole take, no
limiter, nothing else) so the gate can be confirmed by ear at the same
playback level as the approved voices.
Usage: python -I master_replacements.py <repo>
